drafts.title: Dance of Distract
drafts.reasoning: This scene captures the chaotic energy required by the plotpoint while allowing distinct character voices. It sets up the tension between Charlie’s manic distraction and Ursula’s demands.
drafts.scene: The modern kitchen is dimly lit with red strobe lights reflecting off the walls. Bombs explode in the distance, adding an ominous backdrop. Charlie, tied to a counter, frantically spins around, his jumpsuits flailing wildly. Ursula, transformed into a young blonde woman, stands nearby, her eyes fixed on Charlie as he dances.

dialogue.line: Yee-haw! Yee-haw! I’m not letting you ruin my dance party!
Miles! Owen! Do you see what he's doing? We need control here!
Oh no, this isn't about control. This is about dancing and distracting from the apocalypse!
Stop your foolishness! Who do you think you are?
I am the man who turns chaos into jazz—temporal rift or no temporal rift!
You’re going to get us all killed.
Hey now, it’s showtime—and everyone needs a good distraction, right?
